# ProveKit browser runtime provenance

The vendored `dist/wasm/provekit_wasm*` runtime was rebuilt from the ProveKit
`v1` branch at commit `9b2a6f37c67691eab4b0cec6c35e35c520e93285` (ProveKit v1.0.0 line).

Build toolchain:

- Rust `nightly-2026-03-04`
- `wasm-bindgen-cli 0.2.100`
- `wasm-opt 132` with the optimization and thread flags documented in
  `tooling/provekit-wasm/Cargo.toml` at that source commit

The browser wrapper remains vendored from `@atheonxyz/verity 0.3.2-alpha`; the
ProveKit proving and verification core is the source-pinned WASM above.

The SHA-256 demo `prover.pkp` and `verifier.pkv` were regenerated by the CLI at
the same commit. The older Poseidon example is not exposed because its unpinned
`main` dependency no longer compiles against the v1 Noir toolchain.
